en: Black‑and‑white view of a large hilltop castle complex with two tall, steep‑roofed towers and a massive rectangular main building overlooking a river and dense trees. A cobblestone bridge with an arched gate leads toward a house in the foreground, and a lone figure walks across the bridge. The image has wide borders and the aesthetic of an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. No visible text appears on the image.
